Game Overview

Floppy Bird is a animal title where guide a vibrant bird through a dangerous world, tapping to flap past deadly obstacles in Floppy Bird. With easy controls and addictive gameplay, perfect your timing as you navigate narrow spaces. This simple yet challenging adventure offers endless fun and keeps you yearning for just one more flight!
